title: Independent parallel issue handoffs
summary: Owner-enabled parallel schema candidate keeps legacy solo default and same five-stage lifecycle per issue. No fixed team or mandatory coordinator.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve v1 recovery and explicit compatible migration.
Qualify 1–100 simulated clients separately from real independent hosts; no live capacity claim.
No cross-issue changes or automatic merge.

evidence.claim: Draft parallel handoff design and compatibility limits.
Historical 177 tests per platform; separate live checks failed at this candidate.
